title: 'ARIRANG' Extends Billboard 200 Run to 23rd Week as BTS Plays SoFi Stadium Night Two
detail: September 2, 2026 — BTS's fifth studio album 'ARIRANG' logs its 23rd consecutive week on the Billboard 200, ranking No. 31 on the chart dated Sept. 5, 2026, down seven spots from the prior week after debuting at No. 1 in April and holding the top spot for three weeks. Lead single 'Swim' holds No. 4 on Billboard's Global Excl. US chart for a 23rd consecutive week in the Top 5, and sits at No. 17 on the Billboard Global 200; five ARIRANG tracks total have now charted on Global Excl. US for a fifth straight month. The chart update lands the same night as BTS's second of four sold-out SoFi Stadium shows in Los Angeles, held during the city's official 'BTS Week' (Sept 1-8).

media.caption: BTS's 'ARIRANG' extends its Billboard 200 run to a 23rd week.
